instruction: Turn off the BCC feature for my email account to prevent automatic blind carbon copies on sent emails.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling BCC for email identity. The evaluator checks that mail.identity.id1.doBcc is set to false in prefs.js. Current value in profile is already false, so agent needs to ensure it remains disabled (or re-disable if changed). Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.
metadata.verification: Verified by reading prefs.js from cache: mail.identity.id1.doBcc is currently false. Task asks to disable BCC (ensure it's false).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable BCC for email identity
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches Thunderbird prefs.js from VM to local cache
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses prefs.js and checks mail.identity.id1.doBcc equals false
Expected value is semantically correct: mail.identity.id1.doBcc=false means BCC is disabled
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird and waits 0.5s to ensure prefs.js is written to disk before verification
Metric handles edge cases: returns 0.0 if file fetch fails (result is None)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact preference that controls BCC behavior
Static type warning (Union vs str) is a false positive - metric handles both Optional[str] return value correctly

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
